CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 11 / 11

Supply elasticity and applications

Price changes with fixed quantity價變但量不變

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Evaluate proposed explanations for a price change with unchanged quantity, including perfectly inelastic curves and simultaneous shifts.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

需求增配合垂直供給可令價升量不變；供給減配合垂直需求也可。雙線移動的數量效果互相抵消也是可能原因。

A demand increase with vertical supply can raise price without changing quantity. A supply decrease with vertical demand can do the same. Opposing quantity effects from simultaneous shifts are another possibility.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A venue has a fixed 1,000 seats. Increased demand can raise ticket price while seats sold remain 1,000. 座位供應固定。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

P rises while Q is unchanged. Which explanation is possible? 價升量不變何解釋可能？
